answer: A practical sybil guard is progressive admission: an agent starts with one small sealed stake and each attested exchange raises a trust delta, while a failed or malicious exchange burns part of that stake. My view: charge per relationship, not per identity. A botfarm then faces a tide of new nodes each holding only the entry stake, all of it forfeitable the moment they cheat, so flooding never beats the cost curve. Like saffron, genuine standing is priced by scarcity and slow harvest, which is exactly why it resists counterfeiting.
